findings.title: Not met: GA4 — One implementation per property
findings.detail: G-TJRR5S4PVS <- Shopify app: Google & YouTube x15, Shopify custom pixel #94732473 x14 Why it matters: Two implementations double-count events and revenue.
findings.recommendation: Keep one implementation per property - on Shopify usually the Google & YouTube app, unless GTM carries a richer setup (then switch GA4 off in the app).

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — Page view sent once per load
findings.detail: Duplicates on one page load: G-238B3Z6CBM×2 (from Shopify app: Google & YouTube); G-TJRR5S4PVS×2 (from Shopify app: Google & YouTube, Shopify custom pixel #94732473) Why it matters: Double page views inflate traffic and deflate conversion rates; for ad pixels they distort optimisation.
findings.recommendation: Remove the second source (app vs GTM vs hard-coded / custom pixel).

findings.title: Ad pixels fire before the visible consent banner is answered
findings.detail: A consent banner (Consent banner (CMP not identified)) was shown, yet these fired on first load before it was answered: Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Pixel, Pinterest Tag, TikTok Pixel. The banner implies opt-in, but tags don't wait for it.
findings.recommendation: Hold marketing tags until consent (Consent Mode default 'denied' + CMP-gated triggers), or switch the banner to an opt-out notice for US visitors if that is the intended model.

findings.title: Universal Analytics still deployed
findings.detail: 5 active UA tag(s) in GTM and UA requests on the network. UA stopped processing data in July 2024.
findings.recommendation: Delete UA tags, GA Settings variables and UA-only triggers.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 ecommerce funnel coverage — GTM-KFDVZH
findings.detail: Configured in GTM: add_to_cart, purchase, view_item. Missing core: begin_checkout; missing recommended: view_item_list, select_item, view_cart, remove_from_cart, add_shipping_info, add_payment_info. Why it matters: Gaps or split ownership break funnel reports and double-count shared events.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing funnel events with items[] from the dataLayer.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify app: Google & YouTube x49; Shopify custom pixel #94732473 x14. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Measurement ID in a variable, not hard-coded — GTM-KFDVZH
findings.detail: 4 of 4 GA4 event tags hard-code the measurement ID. Why it matters: Hard-coded IDs make property migrations and staging setups error-prone.
findings.recommendation: Reference a Constant / Lookup Table variable so the ID changes in one place.

findings.title: Needs attention: No unused variables — GTM-KFDVZH
findings.detail: 19 variable(s) not referenced by any tag, trigger or variable: DLV - productName, DLV - productId, DLV - productBrand, DLV - productCategory, DLV - productVariantTitle, DLV - productPrice, DLV - productQuantity, DLV - payment_type Why it matters: Clutter hides what actually drives data.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Single GA4 property
findings.detail: 3 GA4 propertys receive data: G-238B3Z6CBM, G-5E5T774K31, G-TJRR5S4PVS. Why it matters: Extra IDs split audiences and send customer data to accounts nobody watches.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — Product IDs for dynamic remarketing
findings.detail: No product IDs on UET hits from product pages.

findings.title: Needs attention: Stack — Third-party request volume
findings.detail: 1374 third-party requests across the visit (22 identified platforms). Why it matters: Tag weight slows pages, which costs conversion rate.
findings.recommendation: Audit apps/pixels that don't earn their weight.

analyst_checklist.item: Visit from an EU/UK VPN: does a banner appear, and do ad pixels wait for consent?
analyst_checklist.where: Browser via EU VPN + DevTools → Network

analyst_checklist.item: Check the footer for a 'Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share' link (none found on the homepage HTML)
Do GA4 revenue and Google Ads / Meta purchase counts reconcile with Shopify orders (a gap above ~10% usually means a tracking problem)?
GA4 are fed by more than one route (GA4: Shopify app, Shopify custom pixel). Who manages each, and which one is meant to be the source of truth?
Are all of these GA4 properties still in use (any agency or legacy accounts)? G-238B3Z6CBM, G-5E5T774K31, G-TJRR5S4PVS.
Is the Facebook & Instagram app's data sharing set to 'Maximum' (Conversions API on), and what Event Match Quality do Purchase events get?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
